definitions.explanation: The knob or lever on a door that one turns or pushes down to open it. Covers both round knobs and lever handles.

examples.japanese: ドアノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ドアノブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: In winter I get a static shock when I touch the doorknob.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧らしく、ドアノブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不在票|ふざいひょう}→不在票：09689_fuzaihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かけて⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A parcel must have come while I was out: a missed-delivery slip was hanging on the doorknob.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドアノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ / ひねる: to turn the doorknob
- ドアノブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to put one's hand on the doorknob
- ドアノブカバー: a doorknob cover

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ノブ→ノブ：27321_nobu⟧: knob; the same thing when the door is clear from context, and also a drawer knob
- ⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧: a handle of any kind (doors, drawers, pots)
